integrity: One analytic finding; exact-arithmetic witness and finite numerical checks are separated from universal proofs.
scientific_limitations: Fixed SPD three-mode family; one-dimensional fixed coarse space; exact arithmetic and one unrelaxed Richardson step; asymptotic minimax and sufficient finite-parameter obstruction, not an exact finite-parameter frontier; no FGMRES claim.
title: Exact-complement preconditioning can destroy Euclidean Richardson safety in three modes
